\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words and verbs — a first pass}

\label{lesson:KA-R153-first-pass-describing-words-and-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to pull and to cry.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item bitter, sour, sweet, lazy, clever
  \item bad, terrible, brave, golden, silver
  \item to drink, to run, to sleep, to cut, to break
  \item to send, to look for, to learn, to teach, to jump
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Bitter? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಹಿ}}, \emph{kahi}.) Sour? (\textbf{\kn{ಹುಳಿ}}, \emph{huḷi}.) Sweet? (\textbf{\kn{ಸಿಹಿ}}, \emph{sihi}.) Lazy? (\textbf{\kn{ಸೋಮಾರಿ}}, \emph{sōmāri}.) Clever? (\textbf{\kn{ಜಾಣ}}, \emph{jāṇa}.) Bad? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೆಟ್ಟ}}, \emph{keṭṭa}.) Terrible? (\textbf{\kn{ಭಯಂಕರ}}, \emph{bhayaṅkara}.) Brave? (\textbf{\kn{ಧೈರ್ಯವಂತ}}, \emph{dhairyavanta}.) Golden? (\textbf{\kn{ಚಿನ್ನದ}}, \emph{cinnada}.) Silver? (\textbf{\kn{ಬೆಳ್ಳಿಯ}}, \emph{beḷḷiya}.) To drink? (\textbf{\kn{ಕುಡಿ}}, \emph{kuḍi}.) To run? (\textbf{\kn{ಓಡು}}, \emph{ōḍu}.) To sleep? (\textbf{\kn{ಮಲಗು}}, \emph{malagu}.) To cut? (\textbf{\kn{ಕತ್ತರಿಸು}}, \emph{kattarisu}.) To break? (\textbf{\kn{ಒಡೆ}}, \emph{oḍe}.) To send? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಳಿಸು}}, \emph{kaḷisu}.) To look for? (\textbf{\kn{ಹುಡುಕು}}, \emph{huḍuku}.) To learn? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಲಿ}}, \emph{kali}.) To teach? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಲಿಸು}}, \emph{kalisu}.) To jump? (\textbf{\kn{ಜಿಗಿ}}, \emph{jigi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:KA-R153-second-pass-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to get down and to join.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to get down, to join, to wear, to call, to count
  \item to wash, to wipe, to sweep, to tie, to sew
  \item to win, to lose, to hide, to protect, to burn
  \item to put out; to choose, to play, to sing, to sell, to walk
  \item to open, to fill, to push, to pull, to cry
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To get down? (\textbf{\kn{ಇಳಿ}}, \emph{iḷi}.) To join? (\textbf{\kn{ಸೇರು}}, \emph{sēru}.) To wear? (\textbf{\kn{ತೊಡು}}, \emph{toḍu}.) To call? (\textbf{\kn{ಕರೆ}}, \emph{kare}.) To count? (\textbf{\kn{ಎಣಿಸು}}, \emph{eṇisu}.) To wash? (\textbf{\kn{ತೊಳೆ}}, \emph{toḷe}.) To wipe? (\textbf{\kn{ಒರೆಸು}}, \emph{oresu}.) To sweep? (\textbf{\kn{ಗುಡಿಸು}}, \emph{guḍisu}.) To tie? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಟ್ಟು}}, \emph{kaṭṭu}.) To sew? (\textbf{\kn{ಹೊಲಿ}}, \emph{holi}.) To win? (\textbf{\kn{ಗೆಲ್ಲು}}, \emph{gellu}.) To lose? (\textbf{\kn{ಸೋಲು}}, \emph{sōlu}.) To hide? (\textbf{\kn{ಬಚ್ಚಿಡು}}, \emph{bacciḍu}.) To protect? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಾಪಾಡು}}, \emph{kāpāḍu}.) To burn? (\textbf{\kn{ಸುಡು}}, \emph{suḍu}.) To put out; to choose? (\textbf{\kn{ಆರಿಸು}}, \emph{ārisu}.) To play? (\textbf{\kn{ಆಡು}}, \emph{āḍu}.) To sing? (\textbf{\kn{ಹಾಡು}}, \emph{hāḍu}.) To sell? (\textbf{\kn{ಮಾರು}}, \emph{māru}.) To walk? (\textbf{\kn{ನಡೆ}}, \emph{naḍe}.) To open? (\textbf{\kn{ತೆರೆ}}, \emph{tere}.) To fill? (\textbf{\kn{ತುಂಬು}}, \emph{tumbu}.) To push? (\textbf{\kn{ತಳ್ಳು}}, \emph{taḷḷu}.) To pull? (\textbf{\kn{ಎಳೆ}}, \emph{eḷe}.) To cry? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಳು}}, \emph{aḷu}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
